name: Internet Depot
summary: ISP that bought Cybonet's internet operations (Feb 2001); no registries or archive evidence of a distinct Australian 'Internet Depot' ISP found (domain never archived, now unregistered).

events.details: First known: bought Cybonet's internet operations.
Website gone (no live site) — Internet Depot drops its 'Internet Access' product; the company continues as a host.

refs.label: Feb 2001 capture: the event that created/expanded Internet Depot, absorbing Cybonet's internet customers (the brief's Feb 2001 acquisition).
Confirms the customer cut-over to Internet Depot occurred in Feb 2001.
Internet Depot's own site (depot.com.au) was still advertising an Internet Access product in Jun 2012.
By Apr 2013 the Internet Access link/product was gone, i.e. the ISP arm had ended while the hosting business continued (still running in 2026).
